about: Closure areas for launches that no other source here carries, each copied from a published copy of the notice and checked against it: North Korea's orbital attempts. A notice's areas are the launch's by the notice's own words or its timing and site (the warning itself names no launch); the source says which. Coordinates are [lon, lat]; times UTC.

source.publisher: NK TechLab, quoting the Philippine NOTAM
source.title: Air traffic warned of rocket drop zone

notices.note: The NOTAMs as quoted give a window from 7 Feb 2016 22:30 UTC, after the launch (00:29 UTC that day): North Korea moved its launch window forward to 7-14 Feb, and the revised notices are not quoted; no window is kept.
